name: sitecoreai-cli
description: Developer-side Sitecore AI / XM Cloud automation as MCP tools — deploy, serialization, recipes, publishing, hygiene, brand, brief, campaign, and workflow.
long_description: scai is the developer-side counterpart to Sitecore's managed Marketer MCP. Where the marketer surface operates pages and content, scai operates deployment runs, environment lifecycle, source-control bindings, serialization sync, Recipe DSL execution, content hygiene, publishing, and brand/brief/campaign automation against Sitecore AI and XM Cloud. This bundle is a thin launcher: it runs your own installed scai build as an MCP stdio server bound to a single environment. Writes are gated — destructive operations require explicit consent and the server honors the environment policy.

scai_cli_path.title: scai CLI entry point
scai_cli_path.description: Path to dist/cli.js inside a built scai checkout (run `npm run build` in the scai repo first), or the cli.js of a global `npm i -g @sitecoreai-labs/sitecoreai-cli` install.

config_path.title: Config file (use your own)
config_path.description: Path to your own sitecoreai.cli.json — e.g. from a project where you have run `scai setup`. The bundle never writes to this file. Leave blank to let the bundle manage its own config from the credential fields below.

environment_name.title: Environment name
environment_name.description: With your own config file, the profile to bind (blank = its defaultEnvProfile). With the bundle-managed config, the name given to the profile built from the credentials below (blank = 'default').

organization_id.title: Sitecore organization ID
organization_id.description: Your Sitecore organization ID (org_…). Needed for the bundle to build its own config.

client_id.title: Automation client ID
client_id.description: Client ID of an OAuth machine-to-machine (automation) client for your organization, created in the Sitecore Cloud Portal.

client_secret.title: Automation client secret
client_secret.description: Client secret for the automation client. Stored by Claude Desktop in the OS keychain and passed to scai as an env var — never written to disk.

deploy_project.title: Deploy project (if prompted)
deploy_project.description: Sitecore Cloud project name or ID. Only needed if `scai setup init` reports that a project must be specified because your organization has more than one.

deploy_environment.title: Deploy environment (if prompted)
deploy_environment.description: Sitecore Cloud environment name or ID within the project above. Only needed if `scai setup init` reports that an environment must be specified.

tools.name: scai_overview
tools.description: Summarize scai's available surfaces and the bound environment.

tools.name: environment_status
tools.description: Report the bound environment's health and identity.

tools.name: explain
tools.description: Explain a scai concept, error, or workflow.

tools.name: deploy_run_start
tools.description: Start a deployment run for an XM Cloud environment.

tools.name: deploy_run_inspect
tools.description: Inspect deployment runs and their status and logs.

tools.name: deploy_environment_lifecycle
tools.description: Provision, promote, or tear down XM Cloud environments.

tools.name: serialization_sync
tools.description: Pull or push serialized Sitecore items between disk and an environment.

tools.name: serialization_publish
tools.description: Publish serialized items after a sync.

tools.name: recipe_plan
tools.description: Plan a Recipe DSL change set without applying it.

tools.name: recipe_push
tools.description: Apply a Recipe DSL change set to an environment.

tools.name: publish_lifecycle
tools.description: Run and manage Sitecore publishing jobs.

tools.name: audit_suite_run
tools.description: Run read-only content and configuration audits.

tools.name: cleanup_preview
tools.description: Preview content hygiene cleanup, such as version pruning, before executing.

tools.name: brand_review
tools.description: Run a brand review against a brand kit.

tools.name: campaign_manage
tools.description: Create, update, or delete Orchestrate campaigns.
